newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta call money traded at 7.25/7.50 percent.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta call money traded at 7.25/7.50 percent.

text.p: Jakarta call money was traded at 7.25/7.50 percent on Thursday morning on the back of ample liquidity, dealers said.
They said an early central bank injection of some 2.089 trillion rupiah was behind the ample supply.
One local bank dealer said the large supply might be due to anticipation of high month-end demand.
Dealers said swap and longer-term rates were easier on the excess rupiah liquidity. Overnight swap was at 0.10/0.15 and tom/next at 0.65/0.75 points.
One- and three-month money were at 13.00/13.25 and 14.00/14.25 percent, respectively.
The central bank offered overnight SBIs at six percent, which should limit further the downside of the overnight money.
The average overnight interbank rate on Tuesday was 9.65 percent, compared with 9.73 percent on Monday.
